newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Spanish bombing cuts short minister's Israel trip.
newsitem.headline: Spanish bombing cuts short minister's Israel trip.

text.p: A car-bomb explosion in Spain prompted Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja to cut short a visit to Israel on Monday to fly to the attack site, a spokesman said.
The minister was ending his trip a day early to fly to the southern city of Granada where one person was killed and seven wounded in the blast believed carried out by Basque separatists.
"I think in two or three hours we'll come back to Granada," the spokesman said. Spanish diplomats said the minister's brief includes police services and anti-terrorism.
In Spain, the Interior Ministry said the explosion, near a military base, was likely to have been carried out by ETA separatists who have fought for 29 years for an independent Basque state.
Interviewed by Spanish state radio earlier, the minister said the attack was proof the government should not enter into talks with ETA.
